C_hunk.before:
return JS_Call(ctx, JS_MKPTR(JS_TAG_OBJECT, pr->u.getset.getter),
                           receiver, 0, NULL);

reason: The property is the only external getter root and can be removed while the getter runs. Duplicate the callee and use actual JS_CallFree exactly as ordinary JS_GetPropertyInternal does.
lifetime_control: A real private accessor deletes its own field and runs actual GC while executing; a native data sentinel must stay alive through the call and retire after a host checkpoint. No immediate DECREF retirement timing assumed.
